headline: Toyota Expected to Post 'Lower Profit' for 5th Straight Quarter Amid Weak Sales, Rising Costs
summary: Analysts expect Toyota Motor's profit to decline for a fifth consecutive quarter on weak sales and rising costs. Investors are also watching the impact of an earthquake in Japan.
why: Toyota is one of the world's largest automakers, and its quarterly results signal the health of global vehicle demand and cost pressures.
